query: SELECT state_code, state_name, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, status, rating, notes, incumbent, incumbent_party FROM senate_races WHERE state_code IN ('IA','MT','NJ','NM','SD') ORDER BY state_code;
